reviews.t: Great product, Hooked on Minerals Now
reviews.x: I knew I could never afford Bare Minerals or BareEscentuals, so when I saw this I had to give it a try. I know a lot of people who are dead set on the name brand gave this stuff bad reviews, but I suggest you ignore them like you do people who insist StarBucks is better than every other coffee. IQ Natural is a great product.  Despite being a sample size, I've had this kit for 5 months, using it 2-4 days a week, and there's still a ton left. I doubt I'll ever use up all the eyeshadow and blush. T

I had not tried mineral makeup in sometime and didn't yet want to invest big bucks into it. This sampler set was a perfect way to save on money while finding the shades I wanted. This is a HUGE sampler set, it is worth every penny! Each container is filled to the brim - which I did not expect. The quality is high in my opinion, it is very fine particles of powder and it is very easy to blend. They include two foundation shades, a veil and a concealer (or the Biisque multi-tasking powder). Lately though the BE makeup just hasn't been agreeing with my skin. I'm getting older and my skin is a bit more sensitive these days apparently. reviews.t: IQ Natural Mineral Makeup Sample Box, Fair
reviews.x: The color is fair which was okay because I am fair skinned and I used the fair 2.  The problem with it was that I broke out on the side of my face and I broke out on my eyelids when I used the eyeshadow.  Stopped using the product because of these breakouts.  Liked the idea that it was natural and organic but just didn't work for me.

reviews.t: Product itself good, but messy in format provided
reviews.x: Love the make-up. Would have been nice if the make-up all had the small plastic lids with holes so I didn't have to dip directly into the powder. Makes it messy and allows for more waste without that. Other brands I have found since offer that so I will use them.

Great product!  5g pots are more than enough for the eyeshadows, but not enough for foundation; but good enough as sampler size.  I will definitely buy more of this stuff.  Brushes are compact and nice to use.
Item arrived on time and as described. The brushes shed alot and the colors are not very vibrant and dont stay on very long.  good for young girls in my opinion

I'm not sure why I never tried mineral makeup before, but I'm really glad that I ordered this kit. I figured it was worth a couple bucks to give it a try. I went from using liquid makeup and a liquid concealer to this and I'm pleased with how light this makeup is. I don't feel like I'm wearing any makeup at all. I'm very light complected so the "fair" shade works really well for me. The size of each container is a little bit bigger than a quarter but it is more than enough for multiple a

I was overall very happy with this product...the foundation was a little powdery/chalky but not a huge issue, the mineral veil was a bit flat..I prefer the Bare Escentuals mineral veil, it has a little 'glow' to it.  However, IQ's overal face color was better for me, it's a little lighter in shade than the BE's version ('warmth'). I didn't care for the IQ's blush, it was really 'shiny' on my face, pearly....reminded me more of an highlighting eyeshadow.  The brushes, eyeshadows are very nice too

reviews.t: always something I like to see
reviews.x: The vials are packed to the top with powder, always something I like to see. Colors are just beautiful, especially for my fair skin tone. As others have said, a little goes a long way, so do follow the directions to use just a pinch and then swirl and tap your brush before applying. You can always apply more if you feel your initial application is too sheer for your liking, but I find that just a tiny amount in the lid does the trick. I love this make up. I have been wearing it for a little of a month now. It took me a bit to apply it faster and now got it down to a science.  It's light weight and stays on. Since I switched to this make up, I look more natural and gotten comments. I did end up buying the full size foundation and switch to medium color. The fair 2 was a tad to light for me (I wear creamy natural). The brushes work great, but wish they were a bit softer. But I would say this is a great starters kit.

reviews.t: small set good for trying before investing in larger sizes
reviews.x: I did return this but only because I purchased it as a gift and I thought it looked too small for a gift. It does have many options for someone buying it to try different options in mineral makeup. The price is great and I have read great things about the quality of IQ Naturals. I purchased another set from IQ naturals with larger sizes that I thought would be more suitable for a gift. I will update after my daughter tries the product.

I love all the products in this line, they're light, easy to apply but provide coverage and flattering color without ever looking garish or overdone. Want to look great with minimal time and product? YOU FOUND IT!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the set to be a great value, with containers generously filled and worth the price.
Several reviewers note the products are very shimmery or sparkly, which some dislike.
Some reviewers compare it favorably to or as a cheaper alternative to Bare Minerals/Bare Escentuals.
A few reviewers report skin breakouts or irritation from using the product.
Some reviewers mention issues with the packaging being messy or brushes shedding.
